metadata.title: Your move · Mudaro
metadata.description: Tell us what you are taking on your move.

home.title: Open the link you received
home.text: This page only works with the link to your request. Ask the moving company for it if you cannot find it.

link.invalidText: It may have been replaced by a new link or be incomplete. Ask the moving company to send it again.
link.errorTitle: Your request could not be opened
link.errorText: Please try again in a moment.

header.title: Hi {name}, what are you taking?
header.subtitle: {company} prepares the quote from what you list here. You can do it bit by bit: it is saved.

expired.title: Editing has closed
expired.text: The inventory can no longer be changed from this link. If you still need to change something, contact {company}.

submitted.title: Inventory sent
submitted.text: {company} received your inventory on {when}. The quote will appear on this same link.

summary.title: Going in the truck
summary.declared: Approximate volume. The company confirms it in the quote.
summary.roomEmpty: No items yet. Use the Add button.

extras.title: Extra services
extras.subtitle: Tick what you would like the company to do. The price appears in the quote.
extras.notePlaceholder: E.g. upright piano, 2nd floor without lift
extras.footnote: If you are not sure what you need, leave everything unticked.

footer.hint: you can go back to any step
footer.hintLast: when you send it, the company receives the inventory

errors.accessIncomplete: Required access details are missing: floor, parking and lift for each address.
errors.empty: Add at least one item before sending.
errors.expired: Editing has closed. Reload the page.
errors.notFound: This link is no longer valid.
errors.noDraft: This inventory has already been sent. Reload the page.
errors.invalid: Some data is not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.failed: Could not save. Please try again.
errors.quoteClosed: This quote is no longer available. Reload the page.
errors.quoteExpired: This quote has expired. Reload the page.
errors.documentChanged: The company sent a new version. Reload the page.

quote.intro: {company} prepared this quote from the inventory you sent. Review the lines, choose the optional extras and accept with your signature.
quote.optionalHint: Tick the optional extras you want to include. The total updates.
quote.hourly: Hourly price: {amount} (crew of {count}). Estimate: {hours} hours. You pay the actual hours.
quote.inventoryHint: The quote was calculated with these items.

accept.title: Accept quote
accept.name: Your name
accept.signatureHint: Sign with your finger or mouse inside the box.
accept.legal: By accepting, you confirm the quote with the chosen extras and a total of {amount}. We keep your name, signature, date and IP address.

reject.title: Decline quote
reject.reasonPlaceholder: E.g. I found another date, the price does not work for me…

accepted.title: Quote accepted
accepted.text: You accepted this quote on {date}, signed by {name}. Total: {amount}. {company} will contact you to arrange the move.

rejected.title: Quote declined
rejected.text: You declined this quote. If {company} sends you a new version, it will appear on this same link.

expired.title: This quote has expired
expired.text: It was valid until {date}. Ask {company} for a new version.

superseded.title: Preparing a new quote
superseded.text: {company} received your updated inventory and will send a new quote to this link.

errors.signatureTooLarge: The signature is too large. Clear it and sign again.
errors.quoteClosed: This quote is no longer available. Reload the page.
errors.quoteExpired: This quote has expired. Reload the page.
errors.documentChanged: The company sent a new version. Reload the page.
errors.invalid: Some data is invalid. Please try again.
errors.failed: Could not send. Please try again.
errors.notFound: This link is no longer valid.
